test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that corrects the following sentence.

All tickets of the FIFA World Cup have been sold away.

options.text: All tickets of the FIFA World Cup have been sold among.
All tickets of the FIFA World Cup have been sold out.
All tickets of the FIFA World Cup have been sold into.
All tickets of the FIFA World Cup have been sold across.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the phrase "**sold away**" which is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**sold out**" which means that all tickets have been purchased.
 
• The phrase **"sold away" **is not commonly used in English and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• Thus, the error is corrected by replacing **"sold away"** with **"sold out".**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"All tickets of the FIFA World Cup have been **sold out.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "sold among" **– This phrase is incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "sold into"** – This phrase is incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "sold across"** – This phrase is incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.
